weekly_theme.summary: 水星目前正在逆行（落在天蠍座，10/24–11/13），這段時間適合放慢腳步、重新確認訊息，避免倉促簽約或做重大決定。 太陽剛進入天蠍座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往天蠍座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，今天可能會為你帶來一些令人困惑的時刻。您可能會發現，由於技術上的打嗝或溝通不暢，財務問題糾纏不清。保持堅持，因為清晰度會隨之而來，而你所面臨的問題也會得到解決。此外，參與新專案的機會可能會引發一些自我懷疑。相信自己的能力，勇往直前。請記住，每位專家都曾經是初學者！
aries.horoscope_en: Today may present some perplexing moments for you, Aries. You might find that financial matters are tangled up due to technical hiccups or miscommunications. Stay persistent, as clarity will come, and the issues you're facing will be sorted out. Additionally, a chance to engage in a new project could spark some self-doubt. Trust in your capabilities and take the leap. Remember, every expert was once a beginner!

taurus.horoscope: Taurus ，由於財務問題，您和您的伴侶可能會感到比必要的壓力更大。看來錢比平時要緊，導致你推遲了一些理想的購買。專注於共同尋找解決方案。今天是在任何敏感事項中找到共同點的絕佳機會，因為你可能有了解情況雙方所需的觀點。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, you and your partner may be feeling a bit more stressed than necessary due to financial concerns. It seems that money is a bit tighter than usual, leading you to postpone some desired purchases. Focus on finding a solution together. Today is an excellent opportunity to find common ground in any sensitive matter, as you're likely to have the perspective needed to understand both sides of the situation.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，你的頭腦今天在翱翔！您可能會發現自己受到新概念的啟發，特別是在政治或社會問題上，激發了深入研究的渴望，無論是在圖書館還是在線上。不過，別忘了，日常責任仍然需要您的關注。這可能會讓你感到有點煩人，因為它會讓你遠離你的智力追求。 如果你能迅速處理這些重要任務，你就可以自由地回到你的探索中，而不會有任何揮之不去的內疚。
gemini.horoscope_en: Gemini, your mind is soaring today! You may find yourself inspired by fresh concepts, particularly regarding political or social matters, igniting a desire to dive deep into research, whether at the library or online. Yet, don't forget that everyday responsibilities still demand your attention. This could feel a bit annoying as it pulls you away from your intellectual pursuits. If you can tackle those essential tasks swiftly, you'll be free to return to your explorations without any lingering guilt.

cancer.horoscope: 今天，巨蟹座，你的創意果汁正在豐富地流動！您可能會發現自己全神貫注於在電腦前寫作，或透過繪畫或音樂表達您的藝術一面。這種創造力的激增深深植根於你的情緒，因此無論可能出現任何幹擾，擁抱它都很重要。盡你的責任，但一定要抽出時間來追求你的藝術熱情。 您可能會對自己創作的傑作感到驚喜！
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, your creative juices are flowing abundantly! You might find yourself engrossed in writing at your computer, or expressing your artistic side through painting or music. This surge of creativity is deeply rooted in your emotions, so it's important to embrace it, regardless of any distractions that may arise. Attend to your responsibilities, but make sure to carve out time to pursue your artistic passions. You could be pleasantly surprised by the masterpieces you create!

leo.horoscope: 今天，獅子座，你可能會發現自己陷入了家庭責任和社會承諾之間的拉鋸戰。雖然聚會的吸引力可能很強，但家中緊迫的情緒問題首先需要您的關注。在這種情況下保持冷靜可能具有挑戰性。在可能的情況下，尋求平衡，讓你能夠滿足家庭的需求，同時仍能享受一段時間的休息。花點時間了解情況！
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you may find yourself caught in a tug-of-war between family duties and social commitments. While the allure of a gathering might be strong, pressing emotional matters at home demand your attention first. Staying calm in this situation could prove challenging. If possible, seek a balance that allows you to address family needs while still enjoying some time out. Take a moment to gain perspective!

virgo.horoscope: 今天，處女座，你可能會發現自己對工作環境的某些方面感到不安。與同事進行對話以緩解任何正在釀造的緊張局勢可能是有益的。優先考慮開放和真誠的對話，以防止任何誤解。保持冷靜，不要讓你的感受決定你的回答。請放心，所有相關問題都會獲得正面解決。 請記住，這只是一個短暫的階段，預計不會產生任何長期影響。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, you may find yourself feeling uneasy about certain aspects of your work environment. It could be beneficial to engage in a conversation with your coworkers to ease any brewing tensions. Prioritize open and sincere dialogue to prevent any misinterpretations. Keep a level head and don’t allow your feelings to dictate your responses. Rest assured, everything will resolve positively for all involved. Remember, this is just a fleeting phase and is not expected to have any long-term repercussions.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，如果你一直在考慮長途飛行，今天你可能會發現自己在猜測你的意圖。對財務或安全的擔憂可能會讓你感到憂慮。請記住，您的擔憂可能比實際情況更激烈。事情可能比看起來更安全。此外，您可能會覺得有興趣參加線上課程或研討會，可能專注於電腦科學或其他技術相關領域。 就像您的旅行計劃一樣，努力保持客觀的觀點。
libra.horoscope_en: Libra, if you've been considering a lengthy flight, today you might find yourself second-guessing your intentions. Concerns about finances or safety could be weighing on your mind. Remember, your worries might be more intense than the reality of the situation. Things could be safer than they seem. Additionally, you might feel drawn to participate in an online course or seminar, possibly focusing on computer science or another tech-related field. Just like with your travel plans, strive to maintain an objective perspective.

scorpio.horoscope_en: You may find it challenging to focus on your ambitions today, especially those related to finances. Old problems could resurface unexpectedly, demanding your attention and resolution. If you're not cautious, these distractions could hinder your progress on various tasks. Remember, staying calm is key to navigating through this day.

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，你的自信通常會閃耀，但今天你可能會發現一些舊的自尊挑戰浮出水面。你可能會覺得自己回到了學校，緊張地被要求說話。這可能會導致您的互動出現一些顛簸，或妨礙您在社交聚會中發光發熱的能力。保持腳踏實地，保持清晰的視角。記住你的真實自我，不要讓過去的不安全感破壞你的能力。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Sagittarius, your confidence usually shines bright, but today you may find some old self-esteem challenges bubbling up to the surface. It might feel as if you're back in school, nervously called upon to speak. This could lead to some bumps in your interactions or hinder your ability to shine at social gatherings. Stay grounded and keep a clear perspective. Remember your true self and don’t allow past insecurities to undermine your capabilities.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，今天你可能會經歷一些腹脹和懶惰，可能會幹擾你的日常活動。工作中缺乏動力也可能會潛入。雖然鍛煉的想法可能對你沒有吸引力，但推進並開始行動至關重要。身體活動可以幫助你清理思緒，為未來的一天設定積極的基調，同時也有助於消除體內多餘的毒素。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, today you may experience some bloating and sluggishness that could disrupt your usual activities. A lack of motivation at work might also creep in. While the thought of exercising may not appeal to you, it's crucial to push through and get moving. Physical activity can help clear your mind and set a positive tone for the day ahead, while also aiding in the elimination of excess toxins from your body.

aquarius.horoscope_en: Aquarius, today you might find yourself needing to tap into your creative talents for a specific task at work or in another endeavor. This might feel a bit overwhelming if it's not something you're accustomed to, but rest assured, you'll have supportive colleagues ready to collaborate with you. Just be mindful that your emotions could run high and potentially disrupt your focus. Keep your composure and stay grounded.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，今天你一直在探索的一個主題可能會激起一些長期隱藏的感覺。你可能會有退縮到思想中的衝動，以處理所有事情，但請記住，過度思考可能無法提供你所尋求的清晰度。避免情緒糾紛，因為交換的話語可能會留下持久的印象。隨著一天的結束，用視覺上迷人的電影來款待自己。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, Pisces, a topic you've been exploring may stir up some long-hidden feelings. You might feel the urge to withdraw into your thoughts to process everything, but remember that overthinking might not provide the clarity you seek. Steer clear of emotional disputes, as words exchanged could leave lasting impressions. As the day winds down, treat yourself to a visually captivating movie.
